title: Gorn
summary_html: Gorn is a powerful warrior who hails from the world of Balema and appears in Ultima V, Ultima VI, and Ultima VII. Finding himself in Britannia after wandering into a moongate,[1] he would dwell there for many years and, at times, become a companion in arms to the legendary Avatar. Like many of otherworldy origin living in the realm, Gorn ages at a considerably slowed rate, his longevity spanning more than two Britannian centuries.
